myself.definition:
pron. I or me in person; -- used for emphasis, my own self or
   person; as I myself will do it; I have done it myself; -- used also
   instead of me, as the object of the first person of a reflexive verb,
   without emphasis; as, I will defend myself.
myself.translation: pron. 我自己, 我亲自, 我独自

mysia.translation: n. 米西亚（小亚细亚一古国）

mysis.definition: n type genus of the family Mysidae

mysoline.definition: n an anticonvulsant (trade name Mysoline) used to treat grand mal seizures and essential tremor

mysophobia.definition: n a morbid fear of dirt or contamination
mysophobia.translation: n. [心]不洁恐怖(指病态的洁癖)

mysophobic.definition: s suffering from mysophobia; abnormally afraid of dirt or contamination

mysore.definition: n. a city in southern India to the southwest of Bangalore
mysore.translation: n. 迈索尔染色棉布；迈索尔（印度南部卡纳塔克邦的旧称）

mystagogical.definition:

mystagogue.definition:
n. interprets mysteries, especially of a religious kind.
n. One who keeps and shows church relics.
mystagogue.translation: n. 神秘主义宗教信条的传播者

mystagogy.definition:
n. The doctrines, principles, or practice of a mystagogue;

mysteries.definition:
n something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained
n a story about a crime (usually murder) presented as a novel or play or movie

mysterious.definition: s. having an import not apparent to the senses nor obvious to the intelligence; beyond ordinary understanding
